summary.en: A narrated tour of a web page: the page scrolls while a voice explains it, its animations run in time. Gives an MP4 and a page to put online.
summary.de: Eine vertonte Tour durch eine Webseite: die Seite scrollt, während eine Stimme sie erklärt, ihre Animationen laufen im Takt. Ergibt ein MP4 und eine Seite zum Online-Stellen.

audience: Visitors of the page who want to be guided through it
tone: Welcoming, concrete and calm; says only what the page says

structure.purpose: Welcome the viewer and say what the tour shows
Walk down the page section by section, one idea per scene
Close with the next step the page offers

rules: Follow the order of the page
Say only what the page says: no number, claim or feature that is not on it
One camera target per scene; point at a figure with a focus when a sentence is about it
avoid: Superlatives the page does not use
Reading the page word for word
